text_pending_judge.text: Tesla discloses that banking institutions have extended credit to Musk secured by pledges of Tesla common stock. It also says he may commit to investing in significant ventures and, as a result, be required to sell Tesla shares to satisfy those commitments.

Tesla warns that if Musk were forced to sell shares, whether pledged to secure personal loan obligations or sold to satisfy other obligations, the sales could cause its stock price to decline. Separately, it says the 2025 CEO Performance Award product goals were designed to incentivize Musk to devote time and energy to developing those products and services, which are directionally consistent with his vision for the company's future.
